gate_restart_and_fork.written: 2026-11-12, by F5's fourth builder, before any of these tests ran
gate_restart_and_fork.claim: the Schwarz flow's prepared response is stored state: a run continued from where the last ended is the uninterrupted run bit for bit; an override of a value the preparation reads (the viscosity) on a run from the start prepares the first step again, so the run is the experiment declared with that value; after the start such an override is refused by name (override.initial-after-start, naming the flow)
gate_restart_and_fork.case: tests/flow/test_schwarz_restart.py (float64; the driven sphere of tests/schwarz_experiments.py, four and two steps)

prediction.unit: continued run: fields differing (0, bit for bit); override: |position - declared position| / |declared position - base position|
prediction.basis: derived: the continued run carries every field and runs the same compiled step (MIME's chunking claims bit for bit); the override's point assembles the flow at the new leaves, whose initial state holds the preparation made at them, the same arithmetic as the declared build's on the same values, so its miss is rounding (expected 0 or about 1e-15 relative)
prediction.why: the preparation is in the flow's initial state, which the override's point re-makes and compares against the base's (study/_override.py: a changed initial state is set on a run from the start and refused after it)

gate_restart_and_fork.metric: the fields that differ; the override's position miss on the scale of the viscosity's own effect on the position

control.plant: restart: the continued run's flow given the initial preparation in place of the stored one; stale: the flow's preparation made at the build's viscosity whatever the override
control.resolution: restart: the initial preparation is the first step's, at the starting pose and the drive's first instant, not the stored step's: every field after it differs; stale: the first step's response at a viscosity off by the drawn factor (1.5 to 3) moves the position by about the first step's share of the viscosity's effect, of order 1e-1 of it, eight decades over the line

gate_restart_and_fork.if_wrong: a continued run that differs would be state the flow does not carry (a field outside its state) or a chunk-dependent program; an override off the declared run past the line would be a leaf the point's assembly does not re-make (a held near-field constant made at the build's viscosity)
gate_restart_and_fork.cannot_discriminate_if: the viscosity does not move the body (no drive), which the test asserts against (moved > 0)

gate_lagged_and_one_way.written: 2026-11-12, by F5's fourth builder, before any of these tests ran
gate_lagged_and_one_way.claim: the declared schemes on the mrs rung: lagged (coupling='lagged') makes one Schwarz pass a step from the last step's tractions; its composed residual (the reflection of the step's change of tractions) is reported and booked in the law's books, every receiver's books close and the law's identity holds with it, and its position after three steps is near the exact one-pass run's; one way (one_way=True) leaves the flow as the flow without the body, delivers nothing (the law's row on the flow zero) and is never a gift
gate_lagged_and_one_way.kind: equality (the books, the one-way flow) and estimate (lagged against exact)
gate_lagged_and_one_way.case: tests/flow/test_schwarz_schemes.py (the driven sphere of tests/schwarz_experiments.py, metered, three steps; the lagged books in both dtypes, its control in float64)

prediction.unit: lagged: |position - one-pass position| / |one-pass displacement| after three steps; the books' identity and the one-way flow within the gate-5 lines (float64 1e-9, float32 1e-3) and 1e-8 relative
prediction.basis: guess from the first step's smoke (probe/f5-cost, D/h 8): under IMEX each product's reflection is about two decades under the near field (GMRES gains two decades a product), so the gain is about 1e-2; the first step starts from zero tractions (an error of about the gain), later steps from the last step's (the gain times the change)
prediction.why: here sqrt(nu dt) = 32 um against a 150 um sphere: the step operator screens the walls' reflection, so one pass from the last tractions is close; the one-way flow is the scheme's step with no body force, the same solves as the bodiless flow's

gate_lagged_and_one_way.metric: lagged: the position's miss on the scale of its displacement; the residual book's work against the identity's line

control.plant: hidden: the lagged run's residual book zeroed (MIME_PLANT_SCHWARZ=hidden), which breaks the law's identity by the residual's work; delivered: the one-way body's composition kept (MIME_PLANT_SCHWARZ=delivered), which moves the flow off the bodiless one
control.resolution: hidden: the residual's work is about the gain times the near field's dissipation, about 1e-2 of it, seven decades over float64's 1e-9 line (float32's 1e-3 line would not resolve it, so the control runs in float64); delivered: the body's force on the flow is the drag's whole size, many decades over 1e-8

gate_lagged_and_one_way.if_wrong: lagged off the exact run past 3e-2 would be a gain near one (the steady limit, or a body near the wall at a step that does not screen it), which the gain/(1-gain) line says diverges; a one-way flow off the bodiless one would be a force left in the grid
gate_lagged_and_one_way.cannot_discriminate_if: the body does not move (no drive) or the lagged residual is zero (no change of tractions between steps)
